title: Define private runner and CodeBuild connectivity to Vault
expected_outcome: A non-secret, fail-closed operating contract specifies the private DNS, TLS, routing, security-group, NetworkPolicy, and evidence requirements for approved runner and CodeBuild paths to Vault.
constraints: Do not deploy, publish, merge, alter secrets, access AWS, or access production.
Do not change a Vault Service type, Terraform, or release.yml.
Do not store certificate material, private endpoint addresses, account identifiers, or credentials.

primary_owner.responsibility: security decisions, integration, and final sign-off

delegations.escalation_trigger: new cloud state or secret is needed
a change would create or modify network, DNS, TLS, Vault, GitHub, or cloud resources

validation: existing Vault GitOps and runner contracts
